title: 2.5inch Pills Crusher, Grinding Bowls, Ceramics Mortar and Pestle,Porcelain Spice Mill Grinder Set, Handheld Seasoning Mills Grinder with Brush
description:
About this item
1. Made of good quality ceramic, thick material and durable.
2. A ceramic garlic mortar and pestle is a kitchen tool used to crush, grind and mix garlic. It provides a simple way to crush and grind , nuts and other substance that is softer than porcelain.
3. You can also crush the pills by using this bowl and make it easy to swallow.
4. The mortar comes with a flat and unglazed bottom for stability and the internal frosted texture can increased friction.
5. There's a brush comes together.So you can take the grinding stuff out of the bowl easily.
6. Easy to clean.You can wash the bowl just using the water or a brush.
